name: epistemic
description: Research-discipline skills for agentic empirical work: falsifiable hypotheses, preregistration, baseline reproduction, statistical rigor, falsification, and kill-or-ship decisions.

interface.longDescription: Use Epistemic to guide empirical work through research-question framing, preregistration, baseline reproduction, experiment execution, statistical rigor, falsification review, surprise triage, kill-or-ship decisions, and publication verification.
defaultPrompt: I want to test whether this approach beats the baseline.
Help me turn this research idea into a preregistered experiment.
